question: After {A4} completely leaves view A, how many red cars in view B overtake {B5}?

observed_information.statement: A4 is visible in view A at 0.0s, and the event report does not observe its exact exit time.
At 0.0s, view B shows a red bus labeled B5 moving toward the camera.
At 10.0-12.0s, red cars are visible behind B5 in view B but are not seen overtaking B5.
At 14.0-16.0s, B5 moves out of the bottom of view B and no red cars overtake B5.
At 18.0-22.0s, red cars are visible in view B but none are clearly seen overtaking the stationary white box truck.
At 18.0-22.0s, view B shows traffic flow with cars B1, B2, and B3 and no red cars overtake B5.

working_relations.statement: v1 and v2 both report A4/B4-related motion near 0.0s, but neither event report identifies the exact frame when A4 completely leaves view A.
v1 reports red cars near a stationary truck at 18.0-22.0s while v2 reports B5 leaving view B by 14.0-16.0s, so v1's later red-car observations may not overlap B5 visibility.
Both v1 and v2 report red cars in view B without a clear overtaking event involving B5 or the stationary truck during the intervals they cover.
